units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|Shortly after landing here, you are approached by a tall Successor in unusual dress; though dark, it shimmers in the light with many little golden flecks. units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	They lead you through several restricted areas of the spaceport to a thin tower on its periphery. The room you enter into is tremendous and circular; an enormous hemispherical tank is suspended above a shallow depression in the center, almost touching the wet floor as it swoops towards downward. The contents of the tank prove even more striking, however: Slowly, what look like the severed limbs of Successors begin to descend, each connected to several glittering golden threads that snake up into the dark abyss of the overhead water. You look around to ask your guide what's happening, but they have already left. At the edge of your vision, an arm rubs up against the glass, its undead suckers making faint popping sounds as they pass over it.|30|0

The room you enter into is tremendous and circular; an enormous hemispherical tank is suspended above a shallow depression in the center, almost touching the wet floor as it swoops towards downward. units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 1|	They splay their arms, a little more subtly than most of the Successors you've seen. "Aqrabe I- Sola. And you are Captain <first> <last>. units.id: conversation:successor keystone delivery|	As soon as you inform traffic control that you are returning with the fifty keystones that House Aqrabe requested, your ship is directed to a side hangar surrounded by multiple small outfitting bays. Most are shuttered, but one is brightly lit and full of activity. It seems to be the domain of some of House Aqrabe's more unorthodox research efforts - the walls are draped with strange-looking fabrics, and a couple of unusual, abstract statues dot its interior. units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Aqrabe 2|Tiliia meets you in another tucked-away part of the spaceport that's filled with strange statuary, where they stand in conversation with a small group of Successors. They brighten as they see you approach and offer a perfunctory splay of the arms. "Captain, captain," they say. "Thou returnest with no time to squander. We mean to ply a journey of understanding cross the wormhole; one fellow captain here means to use one of thy keystones, the other, our weft-weaving armor. Thy own craft would be valuable as a place to gather data from the other two, to see how they perform across the rift."|138|0
